summary: Orléans–Saint-Denis-de-l'Hôtel Airport is a small regional airfield located in the Loiret department of central France, approximately 20 km east of the city of Orléans. The facility primarily serves general aviation, flight training, and recreational flying rather than scheduled commercial services. It provides convenient access to the historic Orléans area and the broader Centre-Val de Loire region.
faqs:
Q: Does Orléans–Saint-Denis-de-l'Hôtel Airport have commercial passenger flights?
A: No, this is a small general aviation airfield with no scheduled commercial passenger service.

Q: What is the airport mainly used for?
A: The airport primarily supports private aviation, flight training, gliding, and recreational flying activities.

Q: Where exactly is the airport located?
A: It is situated in the commune of Saint-Denis-de-l'Hôtel in the Loiret department, about 20 km east of Orléans along the Loire River valley.

Q: Are there customs and immigration facilities?
A: As a small general aviation airport, it does not typically operate scheduled international flights and may have limited customs services available on request.
transport_tips: The airport is most easily reached by car via the A10 motorway and local roads, with parking available on site. There is no direct public transport to the terminal, so arranging a taxi or rental car in advance is recommended. Travel time to central Orléans by car is approximately 25–30 minutes depending on traffic.
local_tip: If flying in, take advantage of the airport's proximity to the Loire Valley châteaux by scheduling a short drive to visit nearby sites like Sully-sur-Loire or Chamerolles before or after your flight.
